_comment: Windsurf Cascade Hooks — deployed at three levels (merged in order of precedence, lowest to highest): workspace (.windsurf/hooks.json), user (~/.codeium/windsurf/hooks.json), system (/Library/Application Support/Windsurf/hooks.json on macOS). System-level hooks cannot be disabled by end users without root. Deploy system hooks via MDM (Jamf, Intune) or config management.

post_tool_call._comment: Fires after each Cascade tool call. Use for audit logging.

post_file_edit._comment: Fires after Cascade edits a file. Scan for accidentally written secrets.

post_setup_worktree._comment: Fires when a new worktree is set up for an agent task. Log for audit trail.

_hook_script_examples.scan-for-secrets.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# Scan the last modified file for secrets patterns
FILE="$WINDSURF_MODIFIED_FILE"
if [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
  if grep -qE '(AKIA[A-Z0-9]{16}|sk-ant-|sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{48}|AIza[A-Za-z0-9_-]{35})' "$FILE"; then
    echo "WARNING: Potential secret detected in $FILE" >&2
  fi
fi

_deployment.jamf: Upload .windsurf/hooks.json as a managed file via Jamf Pro → Management Settings → Managed Software → Packages. Deploy to /Library/Application Support/Windsurf/hooks.json.
_deployment.ansible: Use the 'copy' module to write /Library/Application Support/Windsurf/hooks.json with mode '0644'. Run on all developer workstations.
_deployment.admin_portal: System-level hooks can also be configured via the Windsurf Admin Portal → Team Settings → Hooks, without managing local files.
